given_when_then.given: A customer places an Order Request with items available at multiple Store Partners
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock and creates a Fulfillment Task

given_when_then.given: A customer places an Order Request where no Store Partner has sufficient stock for all items
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: The system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review without creating a Fulfillment Task

given_when_then.given: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity less than the requested quantity for any item
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine evaluates a Store Partner for assignment
given_when_then.then: The system excludes that Store Partner from consideration and does not create a Fulfillment Task

given_when_then.given: Multiple Store Partners have sufficient inventory for the complete order
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine evaluates Store Partners for assignment
given_when_then.then: The system prioritizes and assigns the order to the Store Partner with the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time

given_when_then.given: The Order Allocation Engine assigns an order to a Store Partner
given_when_then.then: Inventory quantities for the assigned items are immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot

success_criteria: Order is successfully assigned to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock when multiple stores qualify
Fulfillment Task is created immediately upon successful order assignment to a Store Partner
Order remains unassigned and flagged for manual review when no Store Partner has sufficient inventory
No Fulfillment Task is created when an order cannot be assigned to any Store Partner
Inventory quantities are immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot upon order assignment
Store Partners with insufficient inventory for any item are excluded from assignment consideration
